licence.leaseMustBeValidToRenew.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), National Industries Park, lease (NIP Rules and Regulations 2024 Rules 6.2 and 7.2(a): a valid Lease and License are needed to operate, and a valid Lease in NIP to qualify for and keep a License; workstation customers may differ, CONFIRMED); https://www.nip.ae/download/1101/

licence.leaseMinRemainingDays.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), National Industries Park, lease (no minimum remaining lease period stated in the NIP Rules 2024); https://www.nip.ae/download/1101/

licence.renewalWindow.value: The Lease and License must be renewed within the time frame set by National Industries Park; no number of days is given.
licence.renewalWindow.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), National Industries Park, renewal window (NIP Rules 2024 Rule 6.3, CONFIRMED. Jafza's three month window is not confirmed to apply to NIP); https://www.nip.ae/download/1101/

licence.renewsTogether.value: Lease and License are renewed together. Conditions: a valid Fitness Certificate for the premises, except NIP provided offices and workstations; a commitment to submit audited annual financials; a valid registration or good standing certificate from the place of incorporation; all dues paid; any other requirement NIP sets. Third party liability and workmen's compensation insurance copies as renewed annually.
licence.renewsTogether.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), National Industries Park, renews together (NIP Rules 2024 Rules 6.3, 7.3 and 10.2.4, CONFIRMED); https://www.nip.ae/download/1101/

licence.afterExpiry.value: The tariff has a licence late payment fee. On termination or invalidity of the Lease or License, the customer must settle dues, cancel or transfer sponsored employees and vacate the premises. No grace period or day threshold for suspension or cancellation after expiry was found.
licence.afterExpiry.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), National Industries Park, late renewal (NIP Rules 2024 Rule 19 and tariff, CONFIRMED; amounts left out. Check whether a company holds an NIP licence or a Dubai Unified License); https://www.nip.ae/download/1101/ ; https://nip.ae/business-setup/

licence.graceDays.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), National Industries Park, late renewal (no grace period found); https://www.nip.ae/download/1101/
